title: Chapter 414
paragraphs: Chapter 414
Episode 120. Why Hairan? (8)
This time, before Ron's formless sword energy could block the cannon, a sword energy shining even more brightly than the cannon blocked its path.
Everyone on the battlefield could not help but be astonished at the scene.
It looked like two giant beams of light intertwined. Linpa's sword energy and the warship Grunnel's cannon had collided.
Paaahhh...!
The cannon shattered, and blue fragments fell like hail. However, this time the other warriors did not have to deal with the fragments.
Ron's formless sword energy swept away the fragments in mid-air, making the fragments disappear without a trace, as if dust was swept away by a strong wind.
Seeing this, Jo could not help but shout.
"My goodness, what's going on?!"
Wobbling...!
The warship Grunnel wobbled to one side. Linpa's sword energy had cut through the cannon, pierced the transparent shield, and directly damaged the hull.
It was possible to do this with a single strike because Ron had been damaging the transparent shield until now.
The overwhelming strength was on a different level.
Linpa's single strike had instilled awe in the warriors on the ground. Indeed, it was the martial prowess worthy of the fourth Nameless King of the extinct strongest battle race.
The Seins didn't know much about the Nameless Clan, so they just thought she was one of Jin's comrades. It was just amazing that such an incredible being was fighting for Jin.
"Ugh, Jo uncle, didn't you say it would be safe once we got back on the ship?!"
Marjiella shouted.
She was being treated aboard the ship along with Bishuel and Bubar after being rescued while Jin and the monster were fighting.
"It was supposed to be, but an unexpected variable suddenly..."
"Marjiella, your wound is open, don't move."
"Ugh, my back! Bishuel, my back!"
"Shut up, Bubar!"
Jo leaned on his cane and stood up to assess the situation again.
At first, he couldn't see properly due to the confusion, but it was undoubtedly the Nameless Clan that had damaged the hull.
It was the basis for the bio-golem 'Nameless' he was researching.
"The Nameless Clan...!"
Jo's eyes widened, and he smiled.
"It's the Nameless Clan, Marjiella! If we secure a specimen, we'll definitely be able to create a perfect Nameless... Kack!"
Bang-!
Another shock hit the inside of the hull.

This time, it was the result of Ron's formless sword energy striking the vanguard. Although the protective shield didn't completely break, the ship was in chaos just from the force of the formless sword.
"Ah!"
"Marziella!"
"My, my back!"
"Sample, we must catch a sample...!"

While each of them was reflexively blurting out words, something dark flew in through the window at the bow. At a glance, it looked like a rock that had bounced off the ground due to the sword fight, but the Kinsellos inside the ship were able to see its gleaming eyes.
It was Linpa.
From the outer wall to the bow of the ship Grenil, she reached with a single leap. The outer wall she jumped from was crumbling, unable to withstand her power.
The Kinsellos swallowed their breaths, and the next moment they faced Linpa's greatsword.
It was as if a giant beast from a myth had swung its claws. The trajectory of the drawn greatsword was large enough to cross the ship Grenil and still have room to spare.
Kwaduduk-! Pajit-!
The dark sword qi scratched the hull.
The altitude of the ship Grenil dropped momentarily, and all kinds of complicated devices that adorned the hull were shattered, and debris fell like powder.
Thud!
As Linpa landed, the ground broke, creating a deep, semicircular crater.
Before the vibrations completely subsided, she leaped again, targeting the lower part of the hull.
'Even the Black Knight Barton used sword qi as propulsion, but the Linpa siblings... they just jump and fly.'
Linpa was known to be strong even among the two kings since training in Lapra Losa, but Jin had never seen her use her full strength.
The memory of initially ridiculing Linpa's silent training flashed through his mind.
Thinking about it again made him feel a bit dizzy.
Jjeoeong...!
As Linpa's greatsword struck the lower part of the hull, a dark hole appeared. A crack as big as a house spread through the hull from a simple stab, nothing special.
And the moment Linpa tried to land again,
A storm of lightning suddenly enveloped the ship Grenil. It was a more violent lightning storm than the hellish cannon fire that had just been shot from the Sword Emperor Castle.
Linpa was swept away by the lightning storm, unable to land.
Caught off guard and floating helplessly in midair, the common thought that passed through the minds of the warriors who saw the scene was:
Could Jin's companion really survive the lightning storm unscathed?
It was a difficult story in the common sense of the warriors. Although it seemed that she could escape by looking at her martial prowess, it was predicted that she would not be unscathed.

Tens of thousands of lightning bolts seemed to strike the ship Grenil. The entire Sword Emperor Castle area was dyed blue with flashes, and the shadows of those standing on the ground lengthened in the light.
Meanwhile, the swords of Ron and Berakt continued to clash. Ron had regained his composure, but he was somewhat tired from protecting the entire Sword Emperor Castle.
Of course, being tired didn't mean that the dignity of the Sword Emperor disappeared. Despite shedding a lot of blood and being exhausted, Ron's intangible sword was becoming sharper.
Jin was still recuperating his body while looking down at the battle from the outer wall, but he didn't worry about Linpa trapped in the storm of lightning at all.
'I didn't know they had such an attack method besides the cannon. Crazy bastards, that will only provoke the Linpa siblings.'
Whirr...!
The storm of lightning was clearing up. And contrary to everyone's expectations except Jin's,
Linpa landed on the ground completely unharmed.
The first words she uttered as soon as she touched the ground were:
"Our... power imitation... fake. Unpleasant......"
The lightning gathered on her greatsword emitted an even sharper light.
Instead of leaping back onto the ship, Linpa turned her gaze towards Lon and Berakt.
She had already destroyed the ship enough to render it nearly inoperative, so she decided that killing the enemies on the ground was a priority.
The White Wolf Tribe.
In fact, since she was first summoned, Linpa had been feeling a strange sensation from the unique scent of the White Wolf Tribe.
Could it be the feeling of encountering a long-forgotten old toy...?
Sensing her gaze, Berakt widened the distance between him and Lon. Now, Berakt was also breathing heavily.
"Join in, I'll deal with both of you at once."
Berakt said in a deep, resolute voice.
The title of the White Wolf Tribe's great warrior is not easily obtained.
It was not an easy task to suppress the absolute fear of the Myungwang Clan, which had been engraved in blood for thousands of years, with a single act of will.
Among the warriors of the present generation, only a handful could suppress that fear with their willpower.
From Berakt's perspective, his claim to face Linpa as well was not a bluff.
He, too, had absolute confidence in his martial prowess as an extreme warrior.
However, from Linpa's point of view, it was no different from a puppy barking.
"You... whether it was before or now... when you're scared, you bark first. You seem to be an outstanding... White Wolf."
Linpa and Lon simultaneously charged at Berakt.
There was no escape. Berakt raised his greatsword to block the two blades at once, and the ground he stood on sank in a large chunk.
"I don't know who you are, but thank you. Thanks to you, my knights can catch their breath."
If this fight had been an honorable one-on-one duel, Lon would never have allowed Linpa's participation.

However, for Lon, this battle was merely about exterminating the terrorists who had attacked the Gyeomhwang Castle and the beasts. There was no need to consider honor in a more efficient way of hunting beasts.
"Greet my... siblings... for I won't remember today's events anyway."
That was the first reason Jin didn't want to call his siblings if he could help it.
Strictly speaking, the Myungwang clan members who stepped forward with their black summons were closer to guardians made of spirit and soul rather than summons.
When their souls return to Lafrarosa, they forget everything they experienced during their time in the world.
Jin thought it was something he shouldn't do to his already forgotten and destroyed siblings.
"Is Jin Runcandel one of your siblings?"
Lon couldn't directly witness Linpa escaping from the black gate while dealing with Berakt.
He was practically defending the entire Gyeomhwang Castle by himself.
"Yes."
"After the battle is over, I'll convey my gratitude personally."
"How dare you... with me right in front of you!"
Berakt roared and swung his greatsword up, but it was impossible to withstand the power of both at once.
Bloodstained fur and flesh were being torn apart.
If they had had air support, they wouldn't have been pushed back so much, but the ship Grenil couldn't gather lightning as quickly as before.
Complete annihilation.
That was Jin's goal. He wanted to destroy Grenil, and if possible, cut off the breath of Berakt, Kinzelro, and the rest of the group.
However, there was one issue he had in mind.
'If the situation is pushed this far, there's a high chance that the leader will appear... just like during the Dark Magic Association, he could escape with them.'
But Lon and Linpa weren't the only ones on the battlefield.
The sky was still filled with dragons, including Murakan and Quicantel, and since no more fragments were falling, the warriors on the ground could rejoin the battle as well.
Even if they tried to escape, it wouldn't be as easy as before.
Jin clenched his teeth, came to that conclusion, and at that moment.
Hiss...!
Suddenly, 'Iron Fragments' began to gather in front of the ship Grenil.
Sensing the iron gate, Murakan landed next to Jin and revealed his energy.
[Jin. It's him.]
"Yes, I knew he'd come. That gentleman is up to no good."
Murakan narrowed his eyebrows in displeasure.
Fortunately, Jin was able to recover his body and prepare a spell before Kinzelro's iron gate was completed.
"Let's deal with that, Murakan."
Jin said, raising his magical power.
